title: Childhood UFO and nasal brain implant at age five

tellings.quote: Uh I remember having experience at age five where um I think that's when they put the brain implant in

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies what he says are alien implants in human bodies, says that at age five in Oxnard, California, he had an encounter with a UFO, and thinks that was when "they put the brain implant in" through his nose. He tells Michels this as his own memory, which, if true, would make him one of the people he studies.
